eps.ov: After a fateful encounter with outlaw Gyro Zeppeli, former racing prodigy Johnny Joestar enters the Steel Ball Run, the first horse race across America.

eps.t: The Sheriff's Request to Mountain Tim
eps.ov: After a shocking end to the 1st STAGE, abnormal murders unfold. Legendary cowboy Mountain Tim steps in to investigate as the tense 2nd STAGE begins.
At camp, Johnny catches a glimpse of Gyro's past. Then the Boomboom Family strikes with an otherworldly power. The duo escape — or so they think.
Caught in the Boombooms' trap, a magnetic force threatens to tear Johnny, Gyro and Mountain Tim apart. They learn about "Stands" and Johnny's body reacts.

eps.t: The Terrorist from a Faraway Country
eps.ov: At a checkpoint, Oye — a man who knows Gyro's past — confronts the duo. His power to turn anything he touches into a bomb leaves them with nowhere to run.
Wounded and weary, the duo finds the Zombie Horse. As Gyro patches himself up, memories surface — revealing a family legacy steeped in duty and sacrifice.
Near Monument Valley, Gyro vanishes into thin air. Alone and under attack, Johnny suspects the mummified arm in his possession has made them both targets.
Johnny awakens a new power and reaches a shocking revelation about the race. Finding hope in the Corpse, he counterattacks to rescue Gyro and protect it.
In the Rocky Mountains, Johnny and Gyro find an injured Diego — and odd changes in his body. When they shelter in a village, a terrifying threat emerges.
Pursued by dinosaur-beasts, Johnny and Gyro uncover clues to the next Corpse Part. Meanwhile, Diego's harsh past and fierce ambition come to light.
